root_cause.offset_2_18: per-SESSION ack/connection GUID (bytes_le form 77393350-13dc-4aed-..., present in ~857/861 frames and learnable as an ASCII guid), NOT a per-frame message id as earlier mislabeled
root_cause.render_write_frame_bug: substituted only the template's 2 session GUIDs, leaving the offset-2 session ack GUID stale -> client rejected the write with a uniform 665 response (the long-standing native_mutation failure)
root_cause.fresh_message_id_bug: regenerating offset-2 with a random uuid clobbered the correctly-rebound ack GUID -> 47 uniform-665 responses

fix: synthesize write/poll frames with navigation.render_form_command (GLOBAL guid rebind handles the ack GUID + session GUIDs in all encodings) + a fresh per-frame nonce at offset 68; never regenerate offset-2

result.conclusion: the synthesized write (and poll) frames are accepted live with zero 665 rejections; the card opens and the write executes. The write-synthesis gate is resolved: render_form_command is the correct write synthesizer. True capture-free synthesis is bounded by the inherent template structure + session-bound GUIDs (ack/SecondaryFrame/ManagedForm) which must be the live values; only the per-frame nonce is freely regenerated.
